title: Agency & FCC Labels
summary: Certified under UL Marking & Labeling Systems – Component PGDQ2 (UL 969), File #MH12483, for indoor and outdoor use and tested to the Canadian cUL standard. RoHS compliant, and available with an LSE adhesive for powder coated surfaces.

title: Dome Labels
summary: Domed urethane coated labels made from white, clear, chrome silver and brushed silver polyester. A .060” clear, non-yellowing urethane coating adds a high end 3-D look, is outdoor durable and can self-repair dents.

title: Warning Labels
summary: Custom warning and caution labels certified under UL 969 (File #MH12483) and made to the ANSI standards for safety signs and labels. Available with an LSE adhesive for powder coated surfaces.

title: Custom Application
summary: Printing directly on flat metal cases, multi-layered acrylic templates, plastic special event tickets and other one-off work, combining digital and conventional printing and cutting for fast turnaround and low set up cost.

title: Graphic Overlays
summary: Durable polycarbonate and polyester overlays with deadfront and LED display windows, selective texture and embossing. UL 969 certified constructions, RoHS compliant.

title: Membrane Switches
summary: Graphic overlays in polycarbonate or polyester thin film combined with membrane circuitry. A membrane switch seals a device from the front and offers colorful graphics, display windows, cut-outs, selective texture and embossed keypads.
